items.source: Abstract ordered implementation of the TestExecutionListener API.
items.translation: 抽象的 ordered 实现，针对 TestExecutionListener API。

items.source: AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader serves as an abstract base class for implementations of the SmartContextLoader SPI that delegate to a set of candidate SmartContextLoaders (i.e., one that supports XML configuration files or Groovy scripts and one that supports annotated classes) to determine which context loader is appropriate for a given test class's configuration.
items.translation: AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader 作为 SmartContextLoader SPI 实现的抽象基类，该实现委托给一组 候选 SmartContextLoaders（即一个支持 XML 配置文件或 Groovy 脚本的加载器，以及一个支持注解类的加载器），以确定哪个上下文加载器适用于给定测试类的配置。

items.source: Abstract application context loader that provides a basis for all concrete implementations of the ContextLoader SPI.
items.translation: 抽象应用程序上下文加载器，为所有具体的 `ContextLoader SPI 实现提供基础。

items.source: Abstract implementation of the TestContextBootstrapper interface which provides most of the behavior required by a bootstrapper.
items.translation: `TestContextBootstrapper` 接口的抽象实现，该接口提供了引导程序所需的大部分行为。

items.source: Abstract base class for TestExecutionListener implementations that provide support for marking the ApplicationContext associated with a test as dirty for both test classes and test methods annotated with the @DirtiesContext annotation.
items.translation: 用于提供支持的 `` 实现的抽象基类，可将带有 `@DirtiesContext` 注解的测试类和测试方法关联的 `` 标记为 dirty。

items.source: Abstract, generic extension of AbstractContextLoader that loads a GenericApplicationContext.
items.translation: 抽象且通用的 AbstractContextLoader 扩展，用于加载一个GenericApplicationContext。

items.source: JDBC support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework, including support for declarative SQL script execution via @Sql.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的 JDBC 支持类，包括通过 @Sql 声明式执行 SQL 脚本的支持。

items.source: Default implementation of the TestContext interface.
items.translation: TestContext接口的默认实现。

items.source: Concrete implementation of AbstractGenericContextLoader that reads bean definitions from XML resources.
items.translation: `AbstractGenericContextLoader` 的具体实现，该实现从 XML 资源中读取 bean 定义。

items.source: Default implementation of the TestContextBootstrapper SPI.
items.translation: 默认实现 `TestContextBootstrapper` SPI。

items.source: Test event support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 测试事件支持类，用于Spring 测试上下文框架。

items.source: Support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
Transactional support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 用于Spring TestContext Framework的事务支持类。

items.source: Web support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的 Web 支持类。

items.source: Support case-by-case Bean overriding in Spring tests.
items.translation: 支持在 Spring 测试中逐案覆盖 Bean。

items.source: Bean overriding mechanism based on Mockito mocking and spying.
items.translation: 基于 Mockito 模拟和间谍的 Bean 覆盖机制。

items.source:
Strategy for providing named properties — for example, for looking up
key-value pairs in a generic fashion.
items.translation: 提供命名属性的策略——例如，以通用方式查找键值对。
